ITEM 1 | Browned meat pieces in irregular chunks, dark brown with seared edges and some lighter tan interior, slightly glossy, sitting in a cluster in the upper center of the plate, roughly 9 x 12 cm footprint and about 1.5 cm thick | 95
ITEM 2 | Cooked carrot slices, bright orange, glossy and soft-looking, cut into rounded coins about 2.5 cm across and 0.5 cm thick, overlapping in a loose pile at the lower left of the plate | 25
ITEM 3 | Thin strip of bright red pepper, glossy and smooth, about 7 cm long and 1 cm wide, lying diagonally across the meat | 5
ITEM 4 | Pale off-white starchy portion, granular and clumped with a slightly moist look, small mound about 3 x 4 cm and 1 cm high, next to the broccoli on the right side of the meat | 15
ITEM 5 | Dark green florets with bumpy, knobbed tops and lighter stems, small cluster about 3 x 4 cm at the right edge of the meat and rice | 10
